shared_elements: a series of parallel short strokes forming a comb-like/hatched band
justification: The only shared depicted content is generic: both surfaces carry incised lines including a set of roughly parallel short strokes (the hatched garment/wing detail in A, the comb-like row of strokes in B), something any engraving tradition could produce independently. A shows a fully realised, densely detailed naturalistic winged anthropomorphic figure with wings, fringed robe, held objects and flanking plant motifs, whereas B shows only sparse, ambiguous schematic grooves with no identifiable figure, attributes or compositional scheme.
